description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is this Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM LH&RH Rear Brake Cylinders for the 88.5′ thru 95′ Suzuki Samurai.
Note: Will not fit 86′ thru 88′ models.
These are the Hydraulic Cylinders that activate the lever assembly to engage the rear brake shoes.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Cylinder RH
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Cylinder LH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1988.5 – 1995 All Models
SJ413 1988.5 – 1995 All Models
